$comment: Built-in application profiles, revision 2 (2026-11-26 rebuild; revision 1 is frozen in profiles-v1.json for older deployments and saved profiles). Templates only: they reference catalog ids, are validated at load (src/engine/applications/builtin.ts) and are never edited by the UI. Profiles are additive: ticking several combines their 'defaults' (each app installed once); 'optional' apps are shown unticked as recommendations. Competing tools (PDF readers, remote support, antivirus) are never defaults of two profiles that are meant to be combined. Device profiles are activated by the device answers, not by a checkbox.

profiles.name: Core Essentials
profiles.description: The foundation of every new deployment: Chrome, 7-Zip, VLC, Notepad++, Bitwarden, SumatraPDF (a lightweight PDF reader), ImageGlass (a photo viewer) and the Visual C++ runtimes most programs need. Technical utilities stay optional. Every app stays individually removable.

profiles.name: Everyday / Home
profiles.description: A typical family member or customer: Zoom and Teams for calls, LibreOffice for documents, Everything for finding files and Revo Uninstaller for clean removals. Messaging, email, cloud storage, music and a remote-support tool are recommendations, never installed twice or in competing pairs.

profiles.name: Gamer
profiles.description: The major game launchers (Steam, Epic Games, Battle.net, GOG GALAXY, Ubisoft Connect, Rockstar Games) and Discord. EA app, Playnite, RetroArch, OBS Studio and gaming utilities are recommendations. No accounts are signed in and no games are downloaded.

profiles.name: Music Lover
profiles.description: Spotify for streaming, MusicBee for the local library, Audacity for editing, mpv.net for playback and Mp3tag for tags. Other players, streaming services and audio tools are recommendations (VLC is already in Core Essentials).

profiles.name: Student / Office
profiles.description: Documents, email, classes and study: LibreOffice, Thunderbird, Teams, PDFsam, Zotero and Anki. Other office suites, note apps and meeting tools are recommendations. Microsoft Office LTSC stays a separate, optional choice below.

profiles.name: Content Creator
profiles.description: Streaming, images, audio and video: OBS Studio, GIMP, Inkscape, Audacity, HandBrake and ShareX. Krita, Blender, video editors and the Adobe and Autodesk app managers are recommendations. No accounts are signed in.

profiles.name: Developer
profiles.description: A sensible development foundation: Git, Visual Studio Code, Python, Node.js LTS and the GitHub CLI. Docker Desktop, GitHub Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, PowerShell 7, WSL, IDEs, languages and AI tools are recommendations.

profiles.name: IT Technician / Network Engineer
profiles.description: Diagnostics, system utilities, networking and remote administration: HWiNFO, CrystalDiskInfo, Sysinternals, WinSCP, PuTTY, Wireshark, Rufus and Revo Uninstaller. Scanners, VPN clients, USB tools and more diagnostics are recommendations. VPNs and remote tools are installed only, never configured.

profiles.name: Remote Support
profiles.description: Lets a technician help this computer remotely: TeamViewer is installed automatically; RustDesk (open source, a manual download because it has no WinGet package) and AnyDesk are alternatives. Tick both deliberately if needed. Installation never turns on unattended access or sets a password: the user accepts each session.

profiles.name: Personal Workstation
profiles.description: The owner's personal additions: VPN, game streaming, media centre, downloads, PlayStation Remote Play and OpenRGB. Peripheral software (Corsair, Logitech, NZXT) and VMware Workstation Pro are optional: install them only for the hardware and needs of the computer. Nothing is signed in or configured.

profiles.name: iPhone / iPad
profiles.description: Activated by an iPhone or iPad under Mobile devices & ecosystem: Apple Devices is recommended and ticked; Apple Music, iTunes and iCloud stay optional.

profiles.name: Android
profiles.description: Activated by an Android phone or tablet. Basic USB file transfer needs no extra software, so nothing is ticked; sharing, phone-link and manufacturer tools are optional.

profiles.name: Laptop
profiles.description: Portable computers: BatteryInfoView to check battery wear, with manufacturer update tools for Dell and Lenovo to choose from.

profiles.name: Touchscreen / 2-in-1
profiles.description: Pen and touch: Xournal++ for handwritten notes and PDF annotation, with Whiteboard and Joplin to choose from.
